verdict.rationale: Oneleet's frameworks page lists ISO 27001 among the frameworks it supports, and its docs show that adding a framework automatically adds controls. Beyond that, nothing shows ISO 27001 being handled as a first-class framework rather than mapped. Missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, certification-audit artifacts or auditor workflow, ISO-specific documentation depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
